scripts.build: for d in packages/*/; do (cd "$d" && bun run build 2>/dev/null) || true; done
scripts.test: bun test tests/all-tasks.test.ts && for d in packages/*/; do echo "Testing $d" && (cd "$d" && bun test) || exit 1; done
scripts.lint: for d in packages/*/; do (cd "$d" && bun run lint 2>/dev/null) || true; done
